events.title: Haunted Halloween in the Haunted Cocktail Garden
events.description:
Join us for a weekend of Halloween fun with our spooky cocktail specials, horror novel book signing from local author, and the therapy pigs!
Celebrate the spookiest time of year all weekend long at the Cooper’s Daughter Spirits Haunted Cocktail Garden!
Book Signing & Sip (Oct 30)
This is your chance to meet author Farrahlynn G. Mullarkey, get your books signed, and pick up some merchandise! There will be a selection of Girl in the Blue Dress themed tote bags, koozies, bookmarks, and stickers. A limited number of books will be available for purchase at the event, and you are welcome to bring your own copy to have signed by the author! To purchase your copy of volume one ahead of time, you can order here: https://a.co/d/6mkbeQY 
A special cocktail themed after the book will be available for purchase! ‘Poppy’s Curse’ features our mulled peach whiskey and black currant liqueur.
The Traveling Therapy Pigs (Oct 31)
Marylin SwineRoe and Albert EinSwine will be having a Halloween bash at Cooper’s Daughter during open hours 12-7! Please feel free to dress spooky chic! Costumes for humans and doggos are encouraged but not mandatory. The pigs love attention, people of all ages, and animals so make sure to take plenty of photos and tag us!
Spooky Themed Cocktails (Oct 30-Nov 1)
For this weekend only we will have our Halloween themed cocktails and mocktails for purchase! Boozy hot chocolates make their debut and even our drinks are dressed up for the holiday!
Address: 284 NY-23, Claverack, NY, 12513

events.title: Poetry Salon with Lou
events.description:
In honor of the one hundredth anniversary of Dorothy Parker’s first publication in the New Yorker (this is a lie but please go with it) we are presenting not only a poetry salon, but a poetry saloon. How is that possible? First, we will read approximately twenty of her poems aloud. We will discuss her style, mechanics, haunting humor and rhyme scheme. Then, with courage, conviction and a contemporary eye, we will write our own poems a la Parker. Satirical, cutting, timely. The workshop with culminate in a reading around CL’s mahogany, rectangular table.

Poetry and pinot noir, anyone?

events.title: MELISSA AUF DE MAUR IN CONVERSATON WITH MICHAEL LANDSAY-HOGG
events.description:
Two artists who helped shape and document defining eras of rock’n’roll come together in their chosen home of Hudson, NY, for a conversation about music, memory, and creative community.

As bassist for Hole and Smashing Pumpkins, Melissa Auf der Maur toured the world with a camera in hand, documenting life backstage, onstage, and in the crowd. She went on to co-found Basilica Hudson, a multidisciplinary arts institution in Hudson. Her 2026 memoir, Even the Good Girls Will Cry, and companion photo book, My ’90s Rock Photographs, offer an intimate portrait of alternative rock’s heyday and a time capsule for Generation X.

Decades before MTV, visual artist and director Michael Lindsay-Hogg was pioneering music videos for The Beatles, The Rolling Stones, and The Who. His films The Rolling Stones Rock and Roll Circus and Let It Be captured rock’s great innovators at a moment of extraordinary change. His 2011 memoir, Luck and Circumstance, recounts a life among cultural icons, while Peter Jackson’s 2024 restoration of Let It Be brought his work to new generation. That same year, Hudson Hall audiences discovered another side of his storytelling through a solo exhibition of his paintings.

Join these two local luminaries as they share stories from two extraordinary chapters in music history and the paths that led them to Hudson. The conversation will be followed by a Q&A, book signing, and reception with music by DJBNNYBRNS.

events.title: Earth Pigments to Paint
events.description:
Space is Limited; Reserve your Spot ~~~ Rain or Shine

Overview:
Make natural inks and paints from soil, clay and rocks. Learn how to forage responsibly, process pigments and mull your own paints and inks. We’ll walk the farm and fields to gather rocks and clay from the creek. After a demonstration, we’ll jump into hands-on work to grind and process these earth materials into artist-quality pigments, paints and inks. Enjoy a delicious farm-to-table lunch in the field.

What You Will Learn:
– How to gather earth pigments responsibly
– Practical methods for processing and making artist-quality pigments from soil, clay and rocks
– Techniques for painting with natural paints and inks on paper

Workshop Highlights:
– Walk the farm and fields to forage for colors
– Take home paints and inks that you have hands-on processed from earth in the barn studio
– Farm-to-table lunch in the field (or greenhouse if rainy)
– Perfect for artists, nature enthusiasts and botany lovers, no experience necessary

Location:
– Jill’s barn studio in Chatham, NY on a serene 200-acre farm
– 25 minutes from Hudson, 25 minutes from Great Barrington, 2 hours north of Manhattan (access via Amtrak to Hudson)

Required materials:
We offer two options for materials to accommodate everyone’s needs: you can bring your own tools or Jill can purchase them for you for an additional $65 available at checkout. Jill will provide all other necessary materials for processing and painting and have any purchased materials waiting for you.

Here are the specific tools you will need:
– Mortar and pestle made of marble, stone, ceramic, or metal (wood is not suitable)
– Tempered glass palette (approximately 11 x 14 inches, plus or minus)
– Glass muller
– Small fine kitchen sieve

What to Bring:
– Required materials above
– A few jars with lids (used, clean jars with lids 12-24 oz is perfect)
– Sketchbook for color swatching and note-taking
– Weather-appropriate layers and waterproof shoes or boots
– Harvesting basket or tote for gathering
– Bring your own earth and rocks if you like as well
– Hands ready to work, questions and a belly ready to eat a delicious meal from the farm

Contact jill@farmandfieldny.com with questions or for recommendations on transportation and where to stay if needed.

No previous experience required, all skill levels and backgrounds are welcome.

Refund policy: Refunds are not available due to the long-term planning involved in our workshops. However, we offer credits that can be applied toward a custom workshop or a future workshop date.

events.title: Sleep: North America 2026
events.description:
Today, the legendary band Sleep releases new single “Have Spacesuit Will Travel” via Third Man Records, their first new music since 2018. In addition, the band announces a fall North American tour, as well as releases the first issue of the Sleep Comic Book, written by bassist and songwriter Al Cisneros.
“Have Spacesuit Will Travel” begins Sleep’s first mission without Matt Pike on guitar. The music and art are alive and after the decades of obstacles that Sleep has overcome, it is time to move forward and make songs and albums. Al wishes Matt the best on his earth bound maneuvers.
Alongside Cisneros, the latest incarnation of Sleep features Dale Crover on drums and Bubba Dupree on guitar. Dale has been in some serious bands, like the Melvins and Redd Kross. That Al would seek him out makes sense, an almost elementary choice that probably wouldn’t raise too many eyebrows. Bubba Dupree, from the fiercely loved band Void, hailing out of Columbia, MD, is a pick that is not only completely mind-blowing, but a choice no one would have seen coming. Just the thought of Bubba, who was amazing from the first Void shows on, playing guitar in Sleep is almost too much for the mind to comprehend.
Al Cisneros, Bubba Dupree, and Dale Crover as a trio looks really good on paper, but the only way to see if it worked was to get everyone in a room and play. Al says the answer made itself evident immediately: “The vibe of the first jam was obvious. It was blue sunglasses-era Iommi in the quality, and equally awesome is Bubba is also one of the coolest people I’ve been able to make music with.”
“Have Spacesuit Will Travel” at no time tries to pick up where The Sciences left off. There’s a considerable amount of new blood in the band, so imitation, as Bubba notes, would greatly limit the potential of three very unique and talented musicians. That being said, Sleep answers to an incredible recorded history, literally decades in the making, so it would not be surprising that Al, Dale and Bubba would find themselves composing in the spirit of that which had been established so long ago. The three of them were able to make an album that can truly be identified as genuine Sleep music, yet with a sharpness and agility to the recordings.

events.title: Basilica Farm & Flea Holiday Market
events.description:
BASILICA FARM & FLEA: Born Thanksgiving Weekend 2013 as the Anti-Black Friday big sister goddess, Basilica Farm & Flea is part timeless flea market, part farmer’s market, part 21st century craft and design fair. Each market features a wide ranging group of regional vendors selling their handmade & collected wares alongside locally-sourced, farm-fresh foods. With over 10,000 square feet of raw space that has been historically and sustainably renovated, Basilica Farm & Flea is one of the only markets of this scale in the region, and is an integral part of Basilica Hudson’s arts and cultural programs.

We are thrilled to host over 140 regional independent businesses made up of artists, artisans, collectors, farmers, chefs, herbalists, publishers , designers & organizations joining us for Basilica Farm & Flea Holiday Market for 2026! With Black Friday Weekend known for big box corporate mass consumerism, we are proud to offer an alternative, where high quality, local and sustainably sourced is the norm. Alongside curated shopping we have many community workshops and craft activities on offer, alongside an abundance of tasty farm fresh food & drink to try! This year will be our biggest Farm & Flea yet, as we are adding an outdoor dining courtyard, expanded marketplace into the Back Gallery, and Germantown based Gatherwild will be popping up a *Tent Village* with their heated canvas tents hosting *farm camp* activities like custom chainstitching on textiles & charm bracelet making. This is a full Basilica Hudson campus take over & we couldn’t be more excited:)

events.title: SAMMY RAE + THE FRIENDS
events.description: For as much as Sammy Rae & The Friends may be a band, this collective of dreamers and artists consider themselves a family first. That all-for-one and one-for-all camaraderie ignites their unforgettable and can’t-miss live shows, which serve as a catharsis for both the musicians and their fervent audience. Fronted by singer/songwriter Sammy Rae and honed through years of touring, the group is capable of flourishing in any spotlight thanks to its signature blend of palpable chemistry, deft virtuosity, and vocal fireworks.
